_doc.purpose: Blind table. `scoring_effect` is the field the scorer actually consumes - spec section 9 flags boss effects that alter scoring (as opposed to drawing) as needing explicit modelling, and this is where that modelling is declared.

scoring_effect_kinds.debuff_suit: Cards of the named suit score nothing and their enhancements/editions do not fire.
scoring_effect_kinds.halve_base: The hand's base chips and mult are both halved before anything else applies.
scoring_effect_kinds.null: No scoring effect. The blind changes drawing, hand limits or economy only, which the scorer does not model but the advisor is told about via effect_description.

_doc.requirement_note: requirement_multiplier is relative to the ante's base score. Small = 1x, Big = 1.5x, most bosses = 2x. The adapter should still write the game's literal `requirement`; this field exists for sanity-checking a manually entered one.

blinds.name: Small Blind
blinds.description: No effect.

blinds.name: Big Blind
blinds.description: No effect.

blinds.name: The Hook
blinds.description: Discards 2 random cards from your hand after every hand you play.

blinds.name: The Ox
blinds.description: Playing your most-played poker hand sets your money to $0.

blinds.name: The House
blinds.description: The first hand of the round is drawn face down.

blinds.name: The Wall
blinds.description: An extra large blind - the score requirement is doubled again.

blinds.name: The Wheel
blinds.description: 1 in 7 cards are drawn face down.

blinds.name: The Arm
blinds.description: Decreases the level of the poker hand you play.

blinds.name: The Club
blinds.description: All Club cards are debuffed and score nothing.

blinds.name: The Fish
blinds.description: Cards are drawn face down after each hand you play.

blinds.name: The Psychic
blinds.description: You must play exactly 5 cards.

blinds.name: The Goad
blinds.description: All Spade cards are debuffed and score nothing.

blinds.name: The Water
blinds.description: You start the round with 0 discards.

blinds.name: The Window
blinds.description: All Diamond cards are debuffed and score nothing.

blinds.name: The Manacle
blinds.description: Your hand size is reduced by 1.

blinds.name: The Eye
blinds.description: No poker hand type may be played more than once this round.

blinds.name: The Mouth
blinds.description: Only one poker hand type may be played this round.

blinds.name: The Plant
blinds.description: All face cards are debuffed and score nothing.

blinds.name: The Serpent
blinds.description: You always draw exactly 3 cards after playing or discarding.

blinds.name: The Pillar
blinds.description: Cards already played this ante are debuffed.

blinds.name: The Needle
blinds.description: You get only one hand to beat this blind.

blinds.name: The Head
blinds.description: All Heart cards are debuffed and score nothing.

blinds.name: The Tooth
blinds.description: You lose $1 for every card you play.

blinds.name: The Flint
blinds.description: The base Chips and Mult of your played hand are halved.

blinds.name: The Mark
blinds.description: All face cards are drawn face down.
